# Setup

Pages are hand-written HTML: `index.html` (English) and `resume_es.html` (Spanish). Keep both in step (WEB-I18N-002). Shared styles and images live in `assets/`; bump `styles.css?v=` when the CSS changes (WEB-SITE-003).

## Preview

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then open `http://localhost:8000/`. Check mobile width, dark mode, and every
language you touched.

## Publish

Pushing to the GitHub Pages branch publishes the site. `_config.yml` keeps
`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, `docs/`, and `scripts/` out of the
published site.
